maria_sales: Hey team — presales POC with VentureQ is blocked. They get 403 when calling generate, saying org/project mismatch.
sam_se: Can you paste the exact curl/log they sent? also any headers they include?
maria_sales: Customer pasted this snippet from their gateway logs:
```
POST /v1/generate 403
Authorization: Bearer svc_eyJ...
X-Company-Org: ventureq
X-Project: dev-team-a
Body: { prompt: "hello" }
Response: { error: "forbidden: org claim \"venture-q\" != header \"ventureq\"" }
```
They think headers are right. Asking if this is a token binding issue or our side.
julio_eng: quick thought — 403 with "org claim != header" usually means the signed token's claims (iss/org/project) don't match the explicit headers. Many gateways rewrite or canonicalize headers (dash removal, lowercasing). Could the proxy be mapping `X-Company-Org` -> `x-company-org` and we validate claim against `Redwood-Org` header instead?
anya_sre: also check if they're using a service key vs an org-scoped API key. Service keys are minted to a specific org/project binding and will 403 if you override headers that contradict the token. Can we confirm token prefix? maria_sales: They sent `svc_` prefix in the header.
sam_se: svc_ prefix -> service token. That explains it. Customer probably is setting headers that conflict with the service token's embedded binding. Two options: remove the extra org/project headers so the token binding takes precedence, or mint a new token matching the headers.
maria_sales: Customer asks which is safer for a short demo. They also asked about whether switching to a trial token avoids this.
julio_eng: For demo, easiest is to have them drop `X-Company-Org` and `X-Project` entirely and let the backend use the token's binding. For longer-term, recommend generating a project-scoped API key for whatever org/project they want to present.
anya_sre: security note — do not ask them to share the raw private key in slack. We can create a throwaway demo key from support console and scope it to `dev-team-a` for the session.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created demo key `demo-svc-01` expiring in 24h (link: https://console.redwood.ai/demo-keys/DEMO-SVC-01)
maria_sales: thanks! I'll pass that along. Also customer had a pricing question: if they exceed free trial token limits during demo, will they be billed automatically?
sam_se: during trial they get grace credits. If they exhaust those, calls will 429 or be rejected depending on account state; we don't auto-bill without explicit upgrade. I'll follow up with billing separately.
maria_sales: one last thing — customer filled a quick security ques for enterprise: they asked if tokens can be org-rotated and audited. reply?
anya_sre: yes — tokens can be rotated via the console or API, and all token use is logged (audit logs). For Private/Dedicated customers we also support KMS-backed keys and HSM integration. I'll DM you the boilerplate wording.
maria_sales: great, sending now. closing this thread once customer confirms demo key works. :thumbsup:
